The consulting practice is not new for me. I ran it once before: for three years
I architected and built Ruby on Rails and Java applications for clients, among
them eBay and New Relic, managed the client relationships, and led a team of
remote subcontractors that reached fifteen engineers. I interviewed candidates,
mentored developers, and did the code and architecture reviews. It is the same
work I am offering now, done before at real scale, with the scars that tell me
which parts actually matter and which are theater.
